subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A baker worked with historians to recreate bread from an old recipe.”?
options: Some people wanted to build a modern shopping center in its place.
Its sound was rougher than the modern bell, but people listened closely.
They did not have modern computers, but they had deep practical knowledge.
The grain was rough, and the bread was heavier than modern bread.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Some people wanted to build a modern shopping center in its place.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Its sound was rougher than the modern bell, but people listened closely.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「They did not have modern computers, but they had deep practical knowledge.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The grain was rough, and the bread was heavier than modern bread.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The grain was rough, and the bread was heavier than modern bread.」，答案為「The grain was rough, and the bread was heavier than modern bread.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The grain was rough, and the bread was heavier than modern bread.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
